title: kingmihailp's mute mod
description: A simple mute mod that blocks players from send messages into chat!
body:
**This mod allows server administrators to mute players on their servers easily!**

USAGE:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/mute (player name) years(y) months(mo) weeks(w) days(d) hours(h) minutes(m) seconds(s) (reason)

/unmute (player name)
